analyst_view.overall: Early view: Monaco host Angers five days before a Conference League trip to Brighton, so Filipe Luis may rotate a little. Angers (16th) have scored only nine goals in 10 games and have one point from their last five league games, while Monaco's league form has been flat despite their European wins.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. I lean lower: Monaco have scored 13 and conceded 11 in 10 league games, and Angers' attack is the second-weakest in the league. A 1-0 or 2-0 Monaco win looks most likely.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners. That looks about right: Monaco average 4.1 corners but should get more at home against a team that sits deep, and Angers win plenty when they get forward (6.0 a game per Statz). No strong reason to move.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.3 cards. That fits two sides that do not foul much: Angers are 15th for fouls (10.4 a game) and Monaco 8th. I would wait for the referee before changing it.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.4 shots, with 16.5 for Monaco. I lean lower: Monaco average only 11.7 shots a game (14th) and had five at Le Mans. Even at home against a weak side, 14 or 15 Monaco shots is more realistic.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.0 shots on target. I lean lower: Monaco average 4.2 on target and Angers 3.1 (17th). Seven or eight looks more likely.
